why: Sketch font names with Regular (OpenSans-Regular) are queried and set upright; only italic and oblique names are italic. The .fixed files differ from the old output (for the symbols-v49 ones, from the BUG-104 output) only in fontStyle normal instead of italic for those runs and in the font queries; in the late-fonts scenarios the OpenSans-Light query merges into the now equal Open Sans normal 400 query.
